museum.blurb: The Apple II most people actually used: ProDOS, a 40-column boot menu, AppleWorks in 80 columns and Dazzle Draw in double hi-res on a 128 KB //e — plus a 2023 Angry Birds for the same machine.
museum.notes: Host-native station: MAME 0.289's apple2ee runs on the host (drawshm frames, ctlsock keys + mouse card, FIFO audio). Boots a ProDOS hard-disk volume (CFFA 2.0 in slot 7) whose STARTUP program is a one-key selector: AppleWorks, Dazzle Draw, Angry Birds, BASIC prompt. Sibling of apple2 (GEOS); the pair shows the same hardware as it was used and as it was later persuaded to look.

reset.mouse: PARTLY FIXED, still an open item -- ships keyboard-only. MEASURED on a live rig 2026-09-08 (pointer stream). Two real mechanisms were found and fixed in the station's MAME binary. (1) A DIFFERENCING WINDOW: a2bus/mouse.cpp update_axis() differences successive reads of the 8-bit a2mse_x/_y field inside +-0x80, so ONE write over 127 counts is read as motion the OTHER WAY (MOVE 127 -> +197 px; MOVE 130/160/200/255 -> the arrow ran LEFT into the clamp). mame-ctlsock-move-step-cap.patch caps the pacing budget at m_ptr_mod/2 - 1 for a narrow accumulator. (2) AN OPEN LOOP CANNOT LEARN A GAIN: with no cursor items MOVEA runs open-loop, learn_gain() is only reached from the closed loop, so m_gx/m_gy stayed at 1.0 and MOVEA issued Delta-px as counts. mame-ctlsock-open-loop-gain.patch adds MAME_CTL_GAIN_X/Y (px per count, default 1.0) seeding the gain at setup and after a state load, converts the open-loop branch px->counts, and fixes that branch's queued-remainder clamp simulation, which was adding COUNTS to a PIXEL belief. With GAIN_X=1.547 GAIN_Y=1.674 and MAME_CTL_SCREEN=1024x768 the SCALE is right -- two interior targets 600 px apart land 0.988x/0.940x of commanded (refined seeds 1.529/1.573) -- but the ORIGIN is not: after the open-loop branch's homing slam the first target lands ~147 px short on X and ~85 px short on Y, and the deficit persists for the rest of the session because an open loop's only origin is its own belief. The homing slam is a hardcoded 18*MOVE_STEP COUNTS, and the guest evidently owes back part of its overshoot before the arrow moves again. Landing errors measured over five targets (300,200)/(700,500)/(150,600)/(900,100)/(300,200): -289,-180 and -148,-88 where the arrow was locatable; the other two put it off the canvas band entirely. NOT within the +-6 px the station would need, so stream.pointer stays transport=none. NEXT: size the open-loop homing slam in PIXELS through the gain instead of in raw counts, and re-measure. MAME_CTL_CAL_X/Y is inert here -- it calibrates a cursor-REGISTER reading that does not exist on this machine.
reset.keyboard: verified on the live rig 2026-09-08 (golden stream): the generated keymap drives the whole visitor path -- [1] into AppleWorks 3.0 (its GETTING STARTED date prompt, then Return to the Main Menu), [2] into Dazzle Draw 1.2 (title, Space to the launcher panel, Return to the canvas), [B] to BASIC. 40/40 ms pacing, no MAME_CTL_KEY_EXCL, no dropped or duplicated characters observed. Rollover/overlap not stress-tested.
reset.fixture: Apple //e (enhanced) ProDOS boot menu -- a tokenized Applesoft STARTUP program on the /HIVE volume (CFFA 2.0, slot 7) offers [1] AppleWorks 3.0, [2] Dazzle Draw 1.2 and [B] BASIC. Apple II Mouse Card in slot 4. MAME 0.289 apple2ee running HOST-NATIVE (drawshm). Cold boot reaches the menu in 2.6 s; the golden savestate restores it in 0.5 s (MEASURED, golden stream 2026-09-08). Reset is a relaunch that restores sta/apple2ee/golden.sta (the MAME savestate captured at the menu 2026-09-08); the restore was proven frame-identical to the cold boot both in-process and across a relaunch.

native stream (2026-09-08): pointer.transport is 'none' ON PURPOSE despite the Apple II Mouse Card being wired at the emulator layer (MAME_CTL_PTR_TAGS/_BTN_NAMES/_MOD in station.env.fixture, mame-ctlsock-ptr-tags.patch) -- InputBackend::MameSock::pointer_mode() in streamhost/streamhost/src/config/backends.rs hardcodes 'abs' for every mamesock station, and the mouse card has no absolute cursor readout (dead-reckoning relative only, unlike newsos's Newport VC2 registers), so this station cannot honestly claim an SPA pointer contract yet. Surfacing a relative mamesock pointer_mode is a daemon change outside this stream; report it to whoever owns spa/backends next.
